items.text: Arizona QB: Carson Beck (back spasms) downgraded to OUT Saturday; 40-year-old Josh Johnson makes his first Cardinals start (team confirmed), rookie Joey Aguilar backs up. Gardner Minshew on IR. Schedule now lists Johnson.

Arizona (final): OUT - QB Carson Beck, G Jon Gaines II (ankle), DL Zach Carter (knee). C Hjalte Froholdt (concussion) and DL Walter Nolen III cleared. IR - S Andrew Wingard, LB Jordan Burch, RBs James Conner and Jeremiyah Love, WR Michael Wilson, OT Paris Johnson II.

Kansas City (final): OUT - RB Kenneth Walker III (groin; Emmett Johnson leads), G Trey Smith (concussion), OT Jaylon Moore (ankle). QUESTIONABLE - DT Omarr Norman-Lott (knee), DL Peter Woods (neck). Sat: RB Nate Carter, C/G Pete Nygra elevated. Patrick Mahomes full all week, starts.
